Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Merciful, Sovereign of the Day of Recompense; Him alone we worship and ask for help and for guidance to the straight path.
Shadows, all creatures in the heavens and earth, and the angels prostrate humbly to Allah, fearing their Lord above them and doing as they are commanded.
Call on Allah or the Most Merciful, for His are the best names; pray neither too loud nor too quiet, and praise Allah, who has no son or partner.
All in the heavens and earth prostrate to Allah, with the sun, moon, stars, mountains, trees, creatures and many people, while punishment is justified upon many others.
All in the heavens and earth, and the birds in flight, exalt Allah, each knowing its prayer, and His are the dominion and the final destination.
All praise belongs to Allah, owner of the heavens and earth, who knows what enters and leaves the earth and what descends from and ascends to the sky.
Allah, Lord of might, is exalted above what they describe; peace be upon the messengers, and praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
All in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah, the Most High; the heavens almost break as the angels exalt Him and ask forgiveness for those on earth.
All praise and grandeur in the heavens and earth belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High, who created and proportioned, destined and guided, and brings out pasture then turns it to black stubble.
